ABOUT

About ArkFlame Studios

ArkFlame Studios

ArkFlame Studios builds Minecraft infrastructure, security, performance, authentication, anticheat and gameplay software.

We build infrastructure software, not resource packs, shaders or client mods. Our products run on the server or proxy, where abuse filtering, load control and network entry protection have to happen.

Each product page lists its own supported platforms and versions. Check that page before you deploy. Nothing here is a guarantee for an environment you haven't tested. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios. ArkFlame Studios is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

What we build

Our catalogue has four areas. Authentication and anticheat sit under security. Proxy and ingress control sit under network. Security products cover crash and dupe exploit protection, packet abuse filtering, combat anticheat and premium authentication bridges. Network software guards the entry point of a network, not a single server.

  • Security

    Exploit protection, anticheat, authentication and abuse prevention for servers and networks.

  • Performance

    Optimization tools for entity load, redstone abuse, runtime stability and high-load servers.

  • Network

    Proxy infrastructure for networks running Velocity or Bungee-compatible proxies.

  • Gameplay

    PvP, practice, minigame and player-facing systems for multiplayer servers.

Products cover legacy and modern Minecraft, including Paper, Folia, Velocity and BungeeCord. Our work focuses on packet handling, concurrency, cross-version compatibility, runtime cost and security boundaries.

Public roots

ArkFlame Network independently documents ArkFlame-branded Minecraft activity from 2013-11-29. That shows the brand's public roots. It does not say when the current company started.

Public product and hub milestones:

  1. FlameCord — verified public BuiltByBit launch: 2020-02-01
  2. VeloFlame — verified public BuiltByBit launch: 2025-10-27
  3. Public article consolidating “ArkFlame Studios as the main hub” — 2026-05-28
  4. FairPlay — verified public BuiltByBit launch: 2026-06-12

Each BuiltByBit entry is the first public release date listed on that product's marketplace page. The 2026-05-28 entry is the public article that made ArkFlame Studios the main hub for the surrounding work. These are release and publication dates, not corporate milestones.

Founder

Founder & Developer

Juan Cruz Linsalata, known online as LinsaFTW, is an Argentine software developer and the builder behind ArkFlame Studios.

LinsaFTW says he has been coding since 2010. That's his personal history, not a start date for this company. He designs, builds and releases the products listed here. Support questions go through the public channels linked on each product page.
